author: Written by Claude (Anthropic) directly as weights. No training, no gradients.
notes: Hidden unit 0 = relu(target - 1 - room): positive only when it's too cold. Hidden unit 1 = relu(room - target - 1): positive only when it's too hot. Hidden unit 2 = window open. Output 'heat' = 1000 x too-cold, 'cool' = 1000 x too-hot, and both get -1,000,000 x window-open so an open window always wins. 'off' has a tiny bias of 0.001 so it wins whenever neither heat nor cool is clearly needed.
